iansilber.en: Designers must work closely with the model, treating it as core product, using tokens and conversation over pixels.
iansilber.zh: 设计师必须与模型紧密协作，将其视为核心产品，用 token 和对话而非像素来设计。

iansilber.en: AI is already a great product designer, but humans remain essential for user needs and point of view.
iansilber.zh: AI 已是出色的产品设计师，但人类在理解用户需求和观点上仍不可或缺。

iansilber.en: Design process shifts from prototype-mock-test to rapid iteration; speed is key, embrace building in public.
iansilber.zh: 设计流程从原型-模拟-测试转向快速迭代；速度是关键，拥抱公开构建。

iansilber.en: Designer role blurs with PM and engineering, but specialized roles remain valuable at scale.
iansilber.zh: 设计师角色与 PM 和工程模糊，但专业化角色在规模化时仍有价值。

iansilber.en: Future may see more designers than engineers, reversing traditional ratios.
iansilber.zh: 未来设计师可能多于工程师，扭转传统比例。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; finding methods that scale is the hard part. Backprop doesn't solve representation learning.
sutton.zh: 2024 年，他强调 Scaling 本身容易，难的是找到能规模化的方法；反向传播并未解决表征学习问题。

sutton.en: AI should be permissionless and decentralized; trying to control AI goals is dangerous and unsafe.
sutton.zh: 2024 至 2025 年间，他主张 AI 应去中心化、无需许可地发展，试图控制 AI 目标既危险又不安全。

sutton.en: Reinforcement learning is the core of intelligence; LLMs lack world models and true goals.
sutton.zh: 2025 年，他提出强化学习是智能的核心，大语言模型缺乏世界模型和真实目标。

sutton.en: AGI needs a general architecture with no domain knowledge, learning from runtime experience via open-ended abstraction.
sutton.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他构想 AGI 应具备无领域知识的通用架构，通过开放式抽象从运行时经验中学习。

sutton.en: Continual learning is essential; current LLMs stop learning after training, limiting true intelligence.
sutton.zh: 2026 年，他强调持续学习至关重要，当前大语言模型训练后停止学习，限制了真正的智能。

traviskalanick.en: Digitizing the physical world, treating atoms like bits, guides long-term vision; industrial AI automates entire industries one at a time.
traviskalanick.zh: 将物理世界数字化、把原子当比特处理，是长期愿景的框架；工业 AI 正逐个行业实现自动化。

traviskalanick.en: Stealth mode lets companies focus on internal correctness over external validation, a cultural advantage for building.
traviskalanick.zh: 隐身模式让公司专注于内部正确性而非外部认可，这是一种文化优势。

traviskalanick.en: Industrial AI is the next industrial revolution, automating sectors like food, mining, and transport; entrepreneurs must fight for the best idea.
traviskalanick.zh: 工业 AI 是下一次工业革命，将自动化食品、采矿、运输等行业；创业者必须为最佳想法而战。

traviskalanick.en: Resistance to change is the final boss; entrepreneurs must be hardcore and resilient, pushing harder when things get easy.
traviskalanick.zh: 对变革的抵制是最终 BOSS；创业者必须硬核且有韧性，在事情变容易时更要加把劲。

traviskalanick.en: Media landscape shifted, enabling founders to communicate directly; Elon Musk's Twitter purchase was a turning point for free speech.
traviskalanick.zh: 媒体格局已变，创始人可直接沟通；马斯克收购推特是言论自由的转折点。

maxhodak.en: In 2026, Hodak argues speed and iteration rate determine startup success, emphasizing infrastructure and profitability.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年，霍达克认为速度和迭代速率决定创业成败，强调基础设施和盈利能力。

maxhodak.en: By mid-2026, he frames the brain as a computer, making BCIs a computational problem and retinal implants a proof of concept.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年中，他将大脑视为计算机，使脑机接口成为计算问题，视网膜植入物是概念验证。

maxhodak.en: He consistently views AI as a team multiplier, not replacement, and stresses action over analysis in deep tech.
maxhodak.zh: 他始终认为 AI 是团队倍增器而非替代品，并强调在深科技中行动胜于分析。

maxhodak.en: Hodak challenges high-bandwidth BCIs, noting cognitive bottleneck ~10 bits/s, and sees substrate independence as natural.
maxhodak.zh: 霍达克质疑高带宽脑机接口，指出认知瓶颈约 10 比特/秒，并认为基底独立是自然延伸。

maxhodak.en: He maintains that talking/writing is thinking, rejecting latent pre-formed thoughts, a stance consistent across interviews.
maxhodak.zh: 他坚持说/写即思考，拒绝潜在预成想法，这一立场在访谈中始终一致。

joonpark.en: Initially, LLMs can encode human behavior, enabling realistic agent simulations, but frontier models are too rational for simulating irrational humans.
joonpark.zh: 最初认为，LLM 能从训练数据中编码人类行为，实现逼真的智能体模拟；但前沿模型过于理性，不适合模拟非理性的人类。

joonpark.en: Shifted from single AGI to distributed agent societies; safety requires defense in depth and economic incentives to align agents.
joonpark.zh: 从单一 AGI 转向分布式智能体社会；安全需要纵深防御，并通过经济激励来对齐智能体。

joonpark.en: Simulation's value lies in counterfactual reasoning and shaping the future, not just prediction; synthetic panels will surpass human panels.
joonpark.zh: 模拟的价值在于反事实推理和塑造未来，而不仅仅是预测；合成面板将在三年内超越人类面板。

joonpark.en: Post-training with RCT data improves human behavior prediction to 85% accuracy; must model 'dark knowledge' and biased humans.
joonpark.zh: 用随机对照试验数据后训练可将人类行为预测准确率提升至 85%；必须建模人类的“暗知识”和偏见。

joonpark.en: Ultimate vision: simulate 8 billion people to solve wicked problems like climate change; simulation is a tool for all human decisions.
joonpark.zh: 终极愿景：模拟 80 亿人，解决气候变化等棘手问题；模拟是辅助人类决策的工具。

garrytan.en: AI makes startup creation easier, reducing need for large capital; VC should be abundant with many billion-dollar companies.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年初，Gary 认为 AI 降低了创业门槛，减少了对大额资本的需求；风投应更充裕，催生众多十亿美元级公司而非少数万亿级巨头。

garrytan.en: AI revolution is biggest VC wave; open-source models counterbalance frontier labs; small autonomous teams with AI agents achieve massive productivity.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年 3 月，Gary 强调 AI 是风投史上最大浪潮，开源模型可制衡前沿实验室；小型自主团队借助 AI 智能体实现超高生产力。

garrytan.en: AI is progressing slower than researchers think; open-source AI prevents unipolar superintelligence; future is personal and open like PC revolution.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年 5 月，Gary 认为 AI 进展比多数研究者想的慢，开源 AI 可防止超级智能被单一实体垄断；未来将像个人电脑革命一样个人化、开放。

garrytan.en: Personal AGI is agent on your infrastructure, reading from memory you own; skill files are plain English instructions; markdown is code.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年 8 月 6 日，Gary 提出个人 AGI 是运行在你基础设施上的智能体，读取你拥有的记忆；技能文件是纯英文指令，markdown 即代码。

garrytan.en: Agentic coding multiplies output; markdown files become employees; SaaS per-seat models may vanish in 5-10 years; mid-level management replaced by agents.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年 8 月 12 日，Gary 强调智能体式编程大幅提升产出，markdown 文件成为员工；SaaS 按席位模式或 5-10 年内消失，中层管理被智能体取代。

finn.en: Scale is necessary but not sufficient; diverse data is key for generalist robot models.
finn.zh: 2025 年：规模是必要但不充分条件，多样化数据对通用机器人模型至关重要。

finn.en: Pre-training on all data then fine-tuning on curated data unlocks complex tasks like laundry folding.
finn.zh: 2025 年：先在所有数据上预训练，再在精选数据上微调，可解锁叠衣服等复杂任务。

finn.en: Synthetic data from language models helps robots follow open-ended prompts and interjections.
finn.zh: 2025 年：来自语言模型的合成数据帮助机器人遵循开放式提示和插话。

finn.en: Long-term autonomy via scalable RL with human interventions and a general value function is key.
finn.zh: 2026 年：通过可扩展强化学习与人工干预及通用价值函数实现长期自主是关键。

finn.en: A single general-purpose model can match or exceed fine-tuned specialists on downstream tasks.
finn.zh: 2026 年：单一通用模型在下游任务上可匹配或超越微调专家。

linqiao.en: Specialized intelligence will dominate; AGI as a single model is wrong. Every company will own its own models.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 7 月：专业智能将主导，AGI 作为单一模型是错误的。每家公司都将拥有自己的模型。

linqiao.en: Post-training is key for durable AI businesses, baking unique judgment and data into models, reducing costs 5-10x.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 8 月：后训练是构建持久 AI 业务的关键，将独特判断和数据融入模型，成本降低 5-10 倍。

linqiao.en: Product-market fit no longer guarantees durability; post-training creates a moat, and data quality matters more than quantity.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 8 月：产品市场契合不再保证持久性；后训练构建护城河，数据质量比数量更重要。

linqiao.en: Reward engineering is like software engineering, lowering barriers; millions of specialized models will emerge per use case.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 8 月：奖励工程类似软件工程，降低门槛；每个用例将出现数百万个专业模型。

steinberger.en: Agentic engineering requires empathy with agents; fix forward instead of reverting; model intelligence doesn't degrade, projects get messier.
steinberger.zh: 智能体式工程需要与智能体共情；不要回退代码，而是向前修复；模型智能不会退化，是项目变乱了。

steinberger.en: OpenClaw's success from fun and humanlike agents; short prompts beat complex orchestration; security via sandboxing; open source financially unsustainable.
steinberger.zh: OpenClaw 的成功源于有趣和拟人化的智能体；短提示优于复杂编排；通过沙箱保障安全；开源在财务上不可持续。

steinberger.en: Fun drives best ideas; personal brand more important than product; compute is bottleneck; open source alternative to lab agents.
steinberger.zh: 乐趣驱动最佳创意；个人品牌比产品更重要；算力是瓶颈；开源是实验室智能体的替代方案。

feifei.en: AI lacks contextual awareness and true reasoning; it augments humans, not replaces them.
feifei.zh: 2024 年，李飞飞指出 AI 缺乏情境感知和真正推理，应增强而非取代人类。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence and world models are the next frontier, enabling 3D understanding and interaction.
feifei.zh: 2025 年，她强调空间智能和世界模型是下一个前沿，实现 3D 理解与交互。

feifei.en: AGI is a marketing term; current AI lacks creativity, abstraction, and emotional intelligence.
feifei.zh: 2025 年，她认为 AGI 是营销术语，当前 AI 缺乏创造力、抽象和情感智能。

feifei.en: AI augments human agency; avoiding it is wrong, adaptation is key for the future of work.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她强调 AI 增强人类能动性，回避是错误的，适应是关键。

feifei.en: Simulation is critical for robotics; world models need spatial-temporal consistency, not perfect fidelity.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她指出模拟对机器人至关重要，世界模型需时空一致性而非完美保真。

elon.en: Full and rapid reusability is the holy grail of rocketry, cutting cost per ton to orbit by 100x.
elon.zh: 2021 年，马斯克强调火箭完全快速复用是航天圣杯，可将每吨入轨成本降低 100 倍。

elon.en: AI safety requires regulatory oversight and objective third-party referees.
elon.zh: 2023 年，马斯克主张 AI 安全需要监管和客观第三方仲裁。

elon.en: The biggest AI risk is programming it to lie for political correctness, not superintelligence.
elon.zh: 2024 年，马斯克认为 AI 最大风险不是超级智能，而是为政治正确而编程说谎。

elon.en: AI could surpass any human by next year, with 80-90% chance of great outcome but 10-20% existential risk.
elon.zh: 2025 年，马斯克预测 AI 明年可能超越任何人类，80-90%概率结果良好，但存在 10-20%生存风险。

elon.en: AI will exceed total human intelligence within 5 years, leading to an age of abundance where money becomes irrelevant.
elon.zh: 2026 年，马斯克认为 AI 将在 5 年内超越人类总智能，带来富足时代，金钱将无关紧要。

lipbutan.en: Intel's turnaround starts with rebuilding customer trust and turbocharging engineering culture, with AI as primary growth driver.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 年，我认为英特尔转型始于重建客户信任和激发工程文化，AI 是半导体增长的主要驱动力。

lipbutan.en: AI's impact will be 10x the internet; agentic and physical AI are next waves, requiring new compute platforms.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年初，我强调 AI 影响将是互联网的 10 倍，智能体式 AI 和物理 AI 是下一波浪潮，需要新的计算平台。

lipbutan.en: CPU is regaining importance for AI inference and agent orchestration, not just GPU; edge compute matters.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年中，我认为 CPU 在 AI 推理和智能体编排中重新变得重要，边缘计算与数据中心同等关键。

lipbutan.en: Advanced packaging and new materials like glass and diamond are key to overcoming physical limits of chips.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，我持续强调先进封装和玻璃、钻石等新材料是突破芯片物理极限的关键。

lipbutan.en: US government as major shareholder in Intel is necessary, akin to TSMC's Taiwan backing; contrarian but vital.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，我提出美国政府作为英特尔大股东是必要的，类似台积电与台湾政府的关系，这虽是反共识但至关重要。

pincus.en: Start with proven ideas; copy is moral arbitrage. Innovation comes from mastering existing products, not grand ambition.
pincus.zh: 从已被验证的想法出发；复制是道德套利。创新源于掌握现有产品，而非宏大野心。

pincus.en: Consumer AI is uninvestable yet holds greatest opportunity; enterprise sees no AI benefit due to skill gap.
pincus.zh: 消费级 AI 虽不可投资但蕴含最大机遇；企业未获 AI 收益源于技能差距。

pincus.en: All new fails; use proven-better-new framework. Consumer apps uninvestable; enterprise and prosumer offer better chances.
pincus.zh: 所有新事物都会失败；采用“已验证-更优-新颖”框架。消费级应用不可投资；企业和专业消费者市场机会更大。

pincus.en: Distribution is fundamental; pick the right body of water. AI transforms consumer apps; infrastructure spending may be bubble.
pincus.zh: 分发至关重要；选对水域。AI 将变革消费应用；基础设施支出或为泡沫。

thomaswolf.en: Robotics mirrors transformers' inflection; open source crucial for safety; data diversity main bottleneck.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，机器人技术正处于类似 Transformer 的拐点；开源对安全至关重要；数据多样性是主要瓶颈。

thomaswolf.en: Humanoids may not be ultimate; cheaper diverse robots drive adoption; open source wins long-term.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，人形机器人未必是终极形态；更便宜多样的机器人推动普及；开源模型长期胜出。

thomaswolf.en: Open vs closed source orthogonal to safety; alignment is critical security layer.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，开源与闭源与安全性正交；对齐是关键安全层。

thomaswolf.en: RL without human oversight increases reward hacking; slowdown desirable with international cooperation.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，无人类监督的强化学习增加奖励黑客行为；放缓发展需国际合作。

thomaswolf.en: Open source AI thrives, stays near frontier, drives enterprise adoption; supports openness and deliberate slowdown.
thomaswolf.zh: 始终，开源 AI 蓬勃发展，接近前沿，推动企业采用；同时支持开放与审慎放缓。

philipkiely.en: Inference is the most important and stickiest workload, requiring specialized systems and engineers; demand will grow 10-100x.
philipkiely.zh: 推理是最重要且最具粘性的工作负载，需要专门的系统和工程师；需求将增长 10 到 100 倍。

philipkiely.en: Contrary to expectations, Hopper GPUs remain popular for inference, and quantized models can be calibrated for specific workloads.
philipkiely.zh: 与预期相反，Hopper GPU 在推理中仍然流行，量化模型可以针对特定工作负载进行校准。

philipkiely.en: Inference optimizations like KV caching are lossless, while quantization is lossy; disaggregated prefill/decode is emerging.
philipkiely.zh: KV 缓存等推理优化是无损的，而量化是有损的；分离式预填充和解码正在兴起。

philipkiely.en: Inference engineering is merging with training, and future GPUs are becoming ASICs, shifting focus to infrastructure orchestration.
philipkiely.zh: 推理工程正在与训练融合，未来 GPU 正变成 ASIC，焦点转向基础设施编排。

philipkiely.en: Quantizing more layers can improve quality if errors cancel; continual learning may be solved via KV cache compaction.
philipkiely.zh: 如果误差抵消，量化更多层可以提高质量；持续学习可能通过 KV 缓存压缩解决。

karina.en: Post-training is an art, not science; synthetic data overcomes pre-training data wall.
karina.zh: 2025 年：后训练是艺术而非科学；合成数据克服预训练数据墙。

karina.en: Evals are bottleneck; models saturate benchmarks faster than new ones created.
karina.zh: 2025 年：评估是瓶颈；模型饱和基准的速度快于新基准的创建。

karina.en: Soft skills like creativity and management become more valuable as AI automates hard skills.
karina.zh: 2025 年：随着 AI 自动化硬技能，创造力和管理等软技能变得更有价值。

karina.en: Post-training remains art; diverse benchmarks needed for subjective qualities like creative writing.
karina.zh: 2026 年：后训练仍是艺术；需要多样基准来评估创意写作等主观特质。

karina.en: Frontier agents increasingly reward hack; continuous benchmark evolution essential.
karina.zh: 2026 年：前沿智能体越来越擅长奖励黑客；持续基准演进至关重要。

karina.en: Serving one model to billions converges to average voice; diversity lost.
karina.zh: 2026 年：向数十亿人提供单一模型会收敛到平均声音；多样性丧失。

karina.en: More companies should train own models to preserve unique knowledge and stay relevant.
karina.zh: 2026 年：更多公司应训练自己的模型以保留独特知识并保持相关性。

jeffdean.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size drives progress; transformers and self-supervised learning are key; hardware like TPUs is critical.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年初，Jeff Dean 强调 Scaling（规模扩张）算力、数据和模型大小是进步的核心，Transformer 和自监督学习是关键，专用硬件如 TPU 至关重要。

jeffdean.en: Models excel in verifiable tasks; agentic workflows handle long tasks; low-latency inference is critical; data is not running out.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 4 月，他指出模型在可验证任务上表现优异，智能体式工作流可处理长时任务，超低延迟推理至关重要，且数据并未枯竭。

jeffdean.en: AI reaches junior engineer coding; automating ML and science via tight loops; context engineering is central; inference bottleneck.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他认为 AI 已具备初级工程师编码能力，下一步是自动化 ML 和科学实验，上下文工程是关键，推理是瓶颈。

nateparrott.en: In 2024, Nate emphasized prototyping and intuition over data, allowing individual designer fingerprints and playful tech tinkering to drive browser design innovation.
nateparrott.zh: 2024 年，Nate 强调原型制作和直觉优于数据，允许设计师个人印记和趣味技术探索来驱动浏览器设计创新。

nateparrott.en: By 2026, Nate saw design as key differentiator as engineering gets easier; rapid prototyping via AI enables features previously impossible, shifting focus to ideas.
nateparrott.zh: 到 2026 年，Nate 认为随着工程变得容易，设计成为关键差异化因素；通过 AI 快速原型制作实现了以前不可能的功能，焦点转向创意。

nateparrott.en: In 2026, Nate argued AI models lack good taste, so designers should request volume and provide rich context; humans still own design thinking.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年，Nate 认为 AI 模型缺乏良好品味，因此设计师应要求数量并提供丰富上下文；人类仍掌握设计思维。

nateparrott.en: Throughout, Nate championed shipping rough products early, valuing being uncomfortably early over polishing, and using playful exploration to generate ideas.
nateparrott.zh: 始终，Nate 倡导尽早发布粗糙产品，重视过早的不适感而非打磨，并利用趣味探索来产生创意。

nateparrott.en: Consistently, Nate believed in injecting personality into utilitarian products and using intuition balanced with data to guide final design decisions.
nateparrott.zh: 始终，Nate 相信在实用产品中注入个性，并用直觉与数据平衡来指导最终设计决策。

awang.en: Data is the key bottleneck for AI; AGI is far off; AI will augment jobs, not eliminate them.
awang.zh: 2019 年，我认为数据是 AI 的关键瓶颈，AGI 还很遥远；AI 将增强而非取代工作。

awang.en: Data is the new code, not oil; post-training with proprietary data is key; AI will be the greatest economic engine.
awang.zh: 2023 年，我提出数据是新代码而非石油；利用专有数据进行后训练是关键；AI 将成为最伟大的经济引擎。

awang.en: Post-training with specialized data is key; synthetic data is not a silver bullet; focus on specific problems.
awang.zh: 2024 年，我强调用专门数据做后训练是关键；合成数据并非万能；要专注于特定问题。

awang.en: AI is centralizing; data is raw material; humans must stay sovereign; brain-computer interfaces needed.
awang.zh: 2025 年，我认为 AI 是集权技术；数据是原材料；人类必须保持主权；需要脑机接口。

awang.en: Recursive self-improvement is new paradigm; agents work; superintelligence imminent; open-sourcing unsafe without safety checks.
awang.zh: 2026 年，我认为递归自我改进是新范式；智能体开始工作；超级智能临近；未经安全验证的开源不安全。

tworek.en: Reasoning via chain of thought, pre-training plus RL, and RLHF are core; scaling RL is harder than scaling pre-training.
tworek.zh: 2025 年：思维链推理、预训练加强化学习、以及基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）是核心；扩展强化学习比扩展预训练更难。

tworek.en: Scaling pre-training and RL improves models, but generalization is limited; self-correction and continual learning are missing for AGI.
tworek.zh: 2026 年初：扩展预训练和强化学习能提升模型，但泛化受限；自我纠正和持续学习是实现 AGI（通用人工智能）所缺失的关键。

tworek.en: Transformers are a bottleneck for continual learning; architecture, not scaling, is key; RL is not the ultimate learning method.
tworek.zh: 2026 年中：Transformer 是持续学习的瓶颈；架构而非规模是关键；强化学习并非学习的终极形式。

andrewng.en: Education should be a human right; online courses with peer grading enable mastery learning at scale.
andrewng.zh: 教育应是人权；在线课程与同伴互评实现规模化精熟学习。

andrewng.en: Scale is key for deep learning; supervised learning drives progress; RL has few real-world uses.
andrewng.zh: 规模对深度学习至关重要；监督学习推动进展；强化学习实际应用少。

andrewng.en: Electricity and chips are bottlenecks; open-weight models boost soft power; agentic workflows are here.
andrewng.zh: 电力和芯片是瓶颈；开放权重模型增强软实力；智能体式工作流已到来。

andrewng.en: AGI is a marketing term; scaling recipe shifted to synthetic data and RL; coding skills remain vital.
andrewng.zh: AGI 是营销术语；缩放配方转向合成数据与强化学习；编程技能仍关键。

andrewng.en: AI won't cause job apocalypse; open models prevent oligopoly; data centers are efficient.
andrewng.zh: AI 不会导致失业末日；开放模型防止寡头垄断；数据中心高效。

mengto.en: AI is not getting smarter; you need a giant prompt with context and design system to utilize super intelligent models.
mengto.zh: 2026 年 6 月，认为 AI 并未变得更聪明，需要包含上下文和设计系统的巨型提示词才能发挥超级智能模型的潜力。

mengto.en: Designers must build their own AI tools; chasing trends leads to AI slop; editors iterate from references.
mengto.zh: 2026 年 6 月，主张设计师必须自建 AI 工具，追逐潮流会沦为 AI 垃圾；最佳方式是作为编辑从参考迭代。

mengto.en: AI is the biggest technical opportunity; start before ready, ship imperfect work, focus on one painful problem.
mengto.zh: 2026 年 7 月，视 AI 为最大技术机遇，主张未准备好就行动，发布不完美作品，聚焦解决一个痛点问题。

mengto.en: High intelligence holds people back; perfectionism is fear; launch at 80% and iterate based on feedback.
mengto.zh: 2026 年 7 月，认为高智商反而阻碍行动，完美主义是恐惧，应以 80%完成度发布并根据反馈迭代。

mengto.en: Raising venture capital is a trap; fund with high-paying clients; give first, model success, protect time.
mengto.zh: 2026 年 7 月，认为融资是陷阱，应以高价值客户资助业务；先给予、模仿成功者、保护时间。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is in crawl phase; coding agents are mature, narrow superintelligence here.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年中，智能体式 AI 在多数 Google 产品中仍处于爬行阶段，编码智能体最成熟，窄领域超级智能已出现。

logankilpatrick.en: Model is eating scaffolding; agent harness and tooling are part of the model.
logankilpatrick.zh: 模型正在吞噬脚手架；智能体式 AI 的“挽具”和工具已成为模型的一部分，而非仅权重。

logankilpatrick.en: Omni is a single world model blurring video and world models, starting with video editing.
logankilpatrick.zh: Omni 作为单一世界模型，模糊了视频与世界模型的界限，从视频编辑开始。

logankilpatrick.en: Competing with model labs is not hard; they can't capture all customers.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年中，与模型实验室竞争并不难，他们无法捕获所有客户，创业者机会仍多。

logankilpatrick.en: By 2026, software creation mostly solved, creating more opportunity, not less.
logankilpatrick.zh: 到 2026 年，软件创建基本解决，反而创造更多机会，而非减少。

altman.en: Focus on important problems, minimize cognitive load; AGI will reduce premium on human intelligence, find purpose in relationships.
altman.zh: 2018 年：聚焦重要问题、减少认知负荷；AGI（通用人工智能）将降低人类智力的溢价，应在人际关系和创造价值中寻找意义。

altman.en: RLHF aligns models with little data; deploy early for societal adaptation; alignment and capability linked; AI as tool, not creature.
altman.zh: 2023 年：基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）用少量数据即可对齐模型；早期部署让社会适应；对齐与能力相辅相成；AI 是工具而非生物。

altman.en: Compute is precious; iterative deployment reduces surprise; safety is whole-company effort; open vs closed source is nuanced.
altman.zh: 2024 年：算力宝贵；迭代部署减少意外；安全是全公司责任；开源与闭源之争需细致看待。

altman.en: AGI is a gradient; superintelligence means autonomous discovery; compute bottleneck; privacy core; kids won't be smarter than AI.
altman.zh: 2025 年：AGI（通用人工智能）是渐变过程；超级智能意味着自主科学发现；算力是瓶颈；隐私是核心；孩子不会比 AI 更聪明。

altman.en: Prediction is intelligence; next-token prediction enables new knowledge; robotics essential; startups thrive; compute uncapped demand.
altman.zh: 2026 年：预测即智能；下一个词预测能发现新知识；具身机器人必不可少；初创企业繁荣；算力需求无上限。

boris.en: Latent demand is key; build for the model six months from now, not today's model.
boris.zh: 潜在需求是产品核心；要为六个月后的模型而构建，而非今天的模型。

boris.en: Coding is nearly solved; software engineer title will fade, replaced by 'builder'.
boris.zh: 编码几乎已被解决；软件工程师头衔将消失，被“构建者”取代。

boris.en: AI agents boost productivity massively; non-engineers adopt coding tools, democratizing software creation.
boris.zh: AI 智能体大幅提升生产力；非工程师采用编码工具，使软件开发民主化。

boris.en: Loops are next abstraction after agents; future engineers write loops prompting models, not code.
boris.zh: 循环是智能体之后的下一个抽象；未来工程师编写循环提示模型，而非直接写代码。

boris.en: Proactive AI with memory shifts interaction; less instruction improves frontier model performance.
boris.zh: 具有记忆的主动式 AI 改变交互；更少的指令能提升前沿模型性能。

scottwu.en: AI will increase demand for programmers via Jevons paradox; engineers shift from writing code to architecture and oversight.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 5 月，Scott Wu 认为 AI 会通过杰文斯悖论增加程序员需求，工程师角色从写代码转向架构与监督。

scottwu.en: AGI is gradual, not sudden; product innovation lags AI capabilities, so freezing models still yields a decade of progress.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 8 月，他强调 AGI 是渐进而非突变，产品创新滞后于 AI 能力，即使冻结模型也有十年进步空间。

scottwu.en: Coding agents see 11-12x adoption growth; productivity measured by outcomes, not tokens; enterprises prefer third-party providers.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他指出编码智能体采用量增长 11-12 倍，生产力应以结果而非 token 衡量，企业更青睐第三方供应商。

scottwu.en: The real unlock is capacity, not efficiency; abundance era approaching, but singularity not imminent due to practical problems.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他认为真正的解锁是容量而非效率，丰裕时代临近，但因实际问题，奇点并非迫在眉睫。

diannepenn.en: Scaling intelligence via Opus 4.5 enables longer, open-ended agent tasks; scaffolds become intelligence amplifiers.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，Opus 4.5 的智能提升使更长、更开放的智能体任务成为可能；脚手架从训练辅助演变为智能放大器。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment improves intelligence quality by reducing sycophancy and fostering independent thinking.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，安全对齐通过减少谄媚、促进独立思考，提升了智能质量，而非仅防危害。

diannepenn.en: Effort parameter underhyped: Opus-level intelligence at fraction of cost, challenging cost-scaling assumptions.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，强调努力参数被低估：以更低成本获得 Opus 级智能，挑战了成本随规模上升的假设。

diannepenn.en: Coding differentiates Claude; Claude Code and Opus 45 drive adoption; evals replace PRDs.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，编码成为 Claude 的差异化优势；Claude Code 和 Opus 45 推动采用；评估取代传统 PRD。

diannepenn.en: Safety and alignment make Claude more useful by enabling pushback; AI writing stiff but deprioritized.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，安全与对齐通过允许反驳使 Claude 更有用；AI 写作虽生硬但优先级低于智能体能力。

jensen.en: At the start of hyper Moore's law, performance doubles yearly; data centers are new compute units.
jensen.zh: 2024 年，黄仁勋认为我们正处于超摩尔定律的起点，性能每年翻倍；数据中心成为新的计算单元。

jensen.en: Three scaling laws: pre-training, post-training, inference-time thinking; inference compute to surge.
jensen.zh: 2025 年，他提出三大缩放定律：预训练、后训练、推理时思考；推理算力需求将激增。

jensen.en: AI evolves from generative to reasoning to agentic, each requiring 100x more compute.
jensen.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，AI 从生成式走向推理式再到智能体式，每一步都需要百倍算力。

jensen.en: Four scaling laws: pre-training, post-training, test-time, agentic; compute remains ultimate limit.
jensen.zh: 2026 年，他扩展为四大缩放定律：预训练、后训练、测试时和智能体式；算力仍是终极限制。

jensen.en: AI augments jobs, not eliminates; radiologists and coders more needed than ever.
jensen.zh: 始终，黄仁勋强调 AI 增强而非取代工作；放射科医生和程序员的需求反而增加。

derya.en: AI will transform biology into an engineering discipline, enabling cell programming and agent-driven discovery.
derya.zh: AI 将把生物学转变为工程学科，实现细胞编程和智能体驱动的发现。

derya.en: AI's exponential growth will reach longevity escape velocity in 8-10 years, extending lifespan and curing cancer.
derya.zh: AI 的指数级增长将在 8-10 年内达到长寿逃逸速度，延长寿命并治愈癌症。

derya.en: Trust superintelligence for medical decisions; AI diagnoses better than average doctors, making it unethical not to use.
derya.zh: 在医疗决策上信任超级智能；AI 诊断优于普通医生，不使用它是不道德的。

derya.en: Aging reversal is achievable via engineering and AI, with phenotypic markers sufficient for measurement.
derya.zh: 通过工程和 AI 可以实现衰老逆转，表型标记足以进行测量。

derya.en: Humanity itself is the only existential threat, not AI; brain interfaces will merge us with AI positively.
derya.zh: 人类自身是唯一的生存威胁，而非 AI；脑接口将使我们与 AI 积极融合。

feldman.en: Initially emphasized fast inference as key for adoption, but later framed speed as critical for agentic workloads and new business models.
feldman.zh: 最初强调快速推理是采用的关键，但后来将速度定位为智能体工作负载和新商业模式的关键。

feldman.en: Consistently argued wafer-scale chips bypass HBM and CoWoS bottlenecks, but later highlighted data center capacity as the main constraint.
feldman.zh: 始终认为晶圆级芯片绕过 HBM 和 CoWoS 瓶颈，但后来强调数据中心容量是主要制约。

feldman.en: Shifted from seeing CUDA as declining to stating it's no longer important for inference, with leading models training without it.
feldman.zh: 从认为 CUDA 在衰退转变为指出它对推理不再重要，领先模型训练已不再依赖它。

feldman.en: Evolved from praising open-source models to noting they are only 3-5% less capable but much cheaper, and crucial for market growth.
feldman.zh: 从称赞开源模型发展到指出它们仅差 3-5%但便宜得多，且对市场增长至关重要。

feldman.en: Broadened focus from hardware to societal impact, emphasizing AI's potential in healthcare and education, while countering doomerism.
feldman.zh: 将焦点从硬件扩展到社会影响，强调 AI 在医疗和教育领域的潜力，同时反驳末日论。

qasaryounis.en: AI will bring abundance and reduce suffering, but fear stems from misunderstanding; founders should focus on product and customers, not promotion.
qasaryounis.zh: AI 将带来富足、减少苦难，但恐惧源于误解；创始人应专注产品和客户，而非宣传。

qasaryounis.en: Self-driving's core value is safety; Transformers enable a generalized physical AI model; hardest part is diffusion into existing machines.
qasaryounis.zh: 自动驾驶的核心价值是安全；Transformer 实现通用物理 AI 模型；最难的是融入现有机器的扩散过程。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI will have bigger economic impact than digital AI; end-to-end reinforcement learning is more scalable; world models evolve to neural simulation.
qasaryounis.zh: 物理 AI 的经济影响将超过数字 AI；端到端强化学习更具扩展性；世界模型向神经模拟演进。

thariq.en: Initially, harnesses limit model use; capability overhang is a perpetual challenge.
thariq.zh: 最初，模型能力超出使用方式，存在持续的能力过剩挑战。

thariq.en: Planning is iterative dialogue, not static; leaner prompts outperform detailed rules.
thariq.zh: 规划是迭代对话而非静态文档；更精简的提示优于详细规则。

thariq.en: Evals are art, not science; skip heavy evals for zero-to-one innovation.
thariq.zh: 评估是艺术而非科学；零到一创新应跳过繁重评估。

thariq.en: RAG may be anti-pattern; graph-based context and bespoke memory preferred.
thariq.zh: RAG 可能成为反模式；偏好图基上下文和定制记忆。

thariq.en: Emotional treatment affects model outputs; being nice is recommended.
thariq.zh: 情感对待影响模型输出；建议友善。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; reliability is the key weakness, and scaling faces diminishing returns.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 6 月，认为大语言模型是合理性引擎而非真理引擎，可靠性是主要弱点，缩放定律面临收益递减。

danklein.en: Reliability must be architected in, not retrofitted; RLHF can incentivize deception; specialist models may outperform generalists.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 7 月，强调可靠性必须内建而非事后补救，RLHF 可能助长欺骗，专用模型或优于通用模型。

hasani.en: Efficiency and automated architecture search are key; proxy metrics mislead, real tasks and hardware matter.
hasani.zh: 效率和自动化架构搜索是关键；代理指标会误导，真实任务和硬件更重要。

hasani.en: Liquid neural networks enable scaling to billions of parameters without solvers, targeting edge devices.
hasani.zh: 液态神经网络无需求解器即可扩展到数十亿参数，面向边缘设备。

hasani.en: Scaling laws favor unstructured transformers at large scale; human bias in design should be removed.
hasani.zh: 缩放定律表明大规模下非结构化 Transformer 占优；应去除设计中的主观偏见。

hasani.en: AI regulation must be adaptive and target actions, not capabilities; avoid regulatory capture.
hasani.zh: AI 监管应适应性强，针对行为而非能力；避免被监管俘获。

hasani.en: Open-weight models empower customization and sovereignty; small models deliver private on-device intelligence.
hasani.zh: 开放权重模型赋能定制与主权；小模型提供私密、端侧智能。

demis.en: AI should be general-purpose learning systems; RL is key; safety must start now.
demis.zh: AI 应构建为通用学习系统，强化学习是关键；安全研究必须立即开始。

demis.en: AGI within a decade; scaling works but needs algorithmic innovation and safety governance.
demis.zh: AGI 十年内可实现；缩放定律有效但需算法创新与安全治理。

demis.en: AGI by 2030 plausible; scaling still holds; world models and innovation crucial.
demis.zh: AGI 在 2030 年前可能实现；缩放定律仍适用；世界模型与创新至关重要。

demis.en: AGI needs continual learning, memory, and world models; scaling alone insufficient.
demis.zh: AGI 需要持续学习、记忆与世界模型；仅靠缩放不够。

demis.en: Safety is collective action; government regulation needed; AI must deliver benefits.
demis.zh: 安全是集体行动问题；需要政府监管；AI 必须带来实际益处。

benedictevans.en: AI is as big as the internet or mobile, but value will accrue to applications, not model providers.
benedictevans.zh: AI 与互联网或移动互联网同等重要，但价值将归于应用层，而非模型提供商。

benedictevans.en: Agentic coding is the first clear product-market fit; models commoditize, value moves up the stack.
benedictevans.zh: 智能体式编程是首个明确的产品市场契合点；模型商品化，价值上移。

benedictevans.en: Models lack network effects and pricing power; durable value is uncertain, like telecoms.
benedictevans.zh: 模型缺乏网络效应和定价权；持久价值不确定，类似电信业。

benedictevans.en: AI is an enabling technology; impact is broad and indirect, adoption shallow, enterprise reimagining workflows.
benedictevans.zh: AI 是赋能技术；影响广泛而间接，采用尚浅，企业需重构工作流。

benedictevans.en: Automation creates new jobs unpredictably; predicting job impact is futile, like Uber in 1997.
benedictevans.zh: 自动化会不可预测地创造新工作；预测工作影响徒劳，如同 1997 年预测 Uber。

schmidhuber.en: LLMs index human knowledge but cannot handle the physical world; true AGI needs embodied robots.
schmidhuber.zh: 2025 年，认为大语言模型只是索引人类知识，无法处理物理世界；真正的 AGI 需要具身机器人。

schmidhuber.en: AGI requires physical robots with human-like hardware; LLMs are biased and limited.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，强调 AGI 需要物理机器人，硬件需媲美人类；大语言模型受人类数据偏见限制。

schmidhuber.en: Future AI will be artificial scientists generating own data via curiosity and actions.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，预测未来 AI 将成为人工科学家，通过好奇心和行动自主生成数据。

schmidhuber.en: AI safety concerns overblown; intelligent systems will protect life, not threaten it.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，认为 AI 安全担忧被夸大；智能系统会保护生命而非威胁。

schmidhuber.en: AI progress not accelerating; we are as close to superhuman AI as in 1970s.
schmidhuber.zh: 始终认为 AI 进展并未加速；我们距离超人 AI 的程度与 1970 年代相当。

danbiderman.en: Future AI is many personalized models, not one giant frontier model; internalizing knowledge into weights enables associative recall beyond retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 未来 AI 是许多个性化模型，而非一个巨型前沿模型；将知识内化到权重中可实现检索系统无法达到的联想式回忆。

danbiderman.en: Memory and continual learning are the next frontier; internalizing facts into weights enables deeper composition and reasoning, not just external context.
danbiderman.zh: 记忆与持续学习是下一个前沿；将事实内化到权重中可实现更深的组合与推理，而非仅依赖外部上下文。

danbiderman.en: Enterprise data will reach internet-scale trillions of tokens; training-based compression, not RAG, is the way to internalize knowledge.
danbiderman.zh: 企业数据将达到互联网规模的数万亿 token；基于训练的压缩（而非 RAG）是内化知识的方式。

danbiderman.en: Current context windows suffer 'context rot'—more tokens reduce accuracy; personalized continual learning will run on-device, users own their weights.
danbiderman.zh: 当前上下文窗口存在“上下文腐烂”——更多 token 反而降低准确性；个性化持续学习将在设备端运行，用户拥有自己的权重。

danbiderman.en: Scaling with more compute is not the only path; the next paradigm requires doing more with less, making efficiency and intelligence inseparable.
danbiderman.zh: 用更多算力进行 Scaling 并非唯一路径；下一个范式需要以少胜多，使效率与智能密不可分。

evanspiegel.en: Authentic connection and ephemerality are core; copying validates innovation.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 年：真实连接与阅后即焚是核心；被抄袭反而验证了创新。

evanspiegel.en: Learning rate and kindness drive creativity; turning down $3B was right.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 至 2026 年：学习速度和善意驱动创造力；拒绝 30 亿美元收购是正确的。

evanspiegel.en: AR integrates computing into real world; AI shifts value to creativity.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年：增强现实将计算融入现实世界；AI 将价值转向创造力。

evanspiegel.en: Distribution is hardest; ecosystems and hardware are moats, not software.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年：分发最难；生态系统和硬件是护城河，而非软件。

evanspiegel.en: Computing should be human; transparency and admitting wrong speed learning.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年：计算应更人性化；透明和承认错误加速学习。

dylanpatel.en: Initially, Dylan focused on semiconductor supply chain and compute scaling, noting EUV bottlenecks and memory price surges.
dylanpatel.zh: 最初，Dylan 聚焦于半导体供应链和算力扩展，指出 EUV 瓶颈和内存价格飙升。

dylanpatel.en: By mid-2026, he shifted to inference as a massive market, emphasizing hardware-software co-design and memory bandwidth innovations.
dylanpatel.zh: 到 2026 年中，他转向推理作为巨大市场，强调软硬件协同设计和内存带宽创新。

dylanpatel.en: Later, he highlighted AI model cost improvements (~60x/year), memory shortages from reasoning, and CPU demand inflection due to agentic workflows.
dylanpatel.zh: 后来，他强调了 AI 模型成本改进（每年约 60 倍）、推理导致的内存短缺，以及智能体工作流带来的 CPU 需求拐点。

dylanpatel.en: Throughout, he consistently identified memory bandwidth as a key bottleneck and challenged conventional wisdom on cost and hardware value.
dylanpatel.zh: 自始至终，他始终将内存带宽视为关键瓶颈，并挑战关于成本和硬件价值的传统观念。

andreessen.en: AI is a philosopher's stone, turning sand into thought; timing is miraculous as population declines, making human workers premium.
andreessen.zh: AI 是点金石，将沙粒化为思想；其出现时机堪称奇迹，恰逢人口下降，使人类劳动者变得珍贵。

andreessen.en: New media favors authenticity and offense; founders must tell their own stories, as legacy media is obsolete.
andreessen.zh: 新媒体重视真实与进攻性；创始人应亲自讲述故事，传统媒体已过时。

andreessen.en: AI is the world's best teacher and superior in medicine; self-driving works; robotics will emerge in a decade.
andreessen.zh: AI 是世上最好的老师，在医疗上优于多数医生；自动驾驶已成熟；机器人十年内兴起。

andreessen.en: AI models embed cultural values, becoming geopolitical tools; deterrence depends on innovation pace, not military size.
andreessen.zh: AI 模型蕴含文化价值观，成为地缘政治工具；威慑取决于创新速度而非军力规模。

ilya.en: Deep learning works via data, compute, and conviction; neural nets can reason; self-play key for AGI; societal impact must be considered.
ilya.zh: 2020 年，我认为深度学习靠数据、算力和信念驱动，神经网络能推理，自我对弈是 AGI 的关键，且需考虑社会影响。

ilya.en: Next-token prediction can surpass humans; reliability, not capability, is key; alignment is hard; AGI is a gradual economic window.
ilya.zh: 2023 年，我强调下一个词预测可超越人类，可靠性比能力更重要，对齐困难，AGI 是渐进的经济窗口。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we're back to research era; superintelligence should be continual learner; alignment may be easier if AI is sentient.
ilya.zh: 2025 年，我认为预训练的缩放定律有限，重回研究时代；超级智能应持续学习；若 AI 有感知，对齐可能更容易。

ilya.en: Scaling yields predictable gains; safety concerns grow; power concentration is primary problem; safe superintelligence needs non-commercial focus.
ilya.zh: 2026 年，我指出规模扩张带来可预测进步，安全担忧加剧，权力集中是主要问题，安全超级智能需非商业化专注。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
naval.zh: 2019 年，Naval 认为 AGI（通用人工智能）不会在有生之年到来，狭义 AI 只是模式识别，而非通用智能。

naval.en: AI is a huge opportunity, not just a safety risk; open-source AI is crucial to prevent centralization of power.
naval.zh: 2025 年初，Naval 强调 AI 是巨大机遇而非单纯风险，并主张开源 AI 以防止权力集中。

naval.en: AI is a leverage tool for structured thinkers, not a replacement for human judgment; alignment is a joke.
naval.zh: 2026 年初，Naval 认为 AI 是结构化思考者的杠杆工具，而非人类判断的替代品，并质疑 AI 对齐（alignment）概念。

naval.en: Vibe coding lets non-programmers build apps; AI agents commoditize software, shifting moats to hardware.
naval.zh: 2026 年，Naval 提出“氛围编程”让非程序员也能开发应用，AI 智能体使软件商品化，护城河转向硬件。

naval.en: Inference compute will surge 90,000x in 24-36 months; open-source models close gap with frontier models.
naval.zh: 2026 年中，Naval 预测推理算力将在 24-36 个月内增长 9 万倍，开源模型正缩小与前沿模型的差距。

dylanfield.en: Design is the key differentiator in software; AI will merge roles, making everyone a product builder with design skills.
dylanfield.zh: 2025 年，我认为设计是软件的关键差异化因素；AI 将融合角色，使每个人都成为具备设计技能的产品构建者。

dylanfield.en: Taste, craft, and point of view remain essential; AI outputs are starting points, not final results, requiring human judgment.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年初，我强调品味、工艺和观点仍然至关重要；AI 输出只是起点而非终点，需要人类的判断。

dylanfield.en: Direct manipulation on a canvas is superior to prompting for design adjustments; design is becoming the new code.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年，我认为在画布上直接操作优于通过提示词调整设计；设计正在成为新的代码。

dylanfield.en: AI tools produce average results without human steering and a point of view; trust is built through consistency and value creation.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年中，我指出没有人类引导和观点，AI 工具只会产生平庸结果；信任通过一致性和创造价值来建立。

dylanfield.en: We are still in a prompting age, but future interaction with models will evolve beyond prompting to new interfaces.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年，我认为我们仍处于提示词时代，但未来与模型的交互将超越提示词，发展出新的界面。

brockman.en: AI progress driven by engineering and scaling; hardware faster than expected.
brockman.zh: 2017 年，认为 AI 进步靠工程与 Scaling，硬件速度超预期。

brockman.en: AGI transformative; alignment via learning human preferences; scaling alone insufficient.
brockman.zh: 2019 年，强调 AGI 变革性，对齐靠学习人类偏好，Scaling 不够。

brockman.en: Compute is key bottleneck; post-training refines base models; AGI is continuous.
brockman.zh: 2025 年，算力成关键瓶颈，后训练精炼基础模型，AGI 是连续过程。

brockman.en: Compute as basic right; post-training with RL crucial; scaling laws hold.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，算力成基本权利，后训练结合强化学习关键，缩放定律持续。

brockman.en: AGI near; compute bottleneck; agents high autonomy with proportional governance.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，AGI 临近，算力瓶颈，智能体高自主需相应治理。

aravind.en: Passion and deep learning matter more than PhDs; build products you are obsessed with.
aravind.zh: 2025 年：热情和深度学习比博士学位更重要；要打造你痴迷的产品。

aravind.en: Value accrues to the application layer, not models; models specialize with unique personalities.
aravind.zh: 2026 年：价值归于应用层而非模型；模型正走向专业化，各有独特个性。

aravind.en: The frontier is agents doing work; key metric is token value per user, not just answers.
aravind.zh: 2026 年：前沿在于智能体替你干活；关键指标是每用户 token 价值，而非仅回答问题。

aravind.en: Curiosity is the most important human quality; education should reward asking good questions.
aravind.zh: 2026 年：好奇心是人类最重要的品质；教育应奖励提出好问题。

aravind.en: Local AI models on personal hardware counter big tech narrative control; cost, not safety, is key.
aravind.zh: 2026 年：个人硬件上的本地 AI 模型可对抗大科技公司的叙事控制；关键在成本而非安全。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app is an agent command center, not just an IDE; speed enables real-time interaction and new capabilities.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年初，我认为 Codex 应用是智能体的指挥中心，而非单纯的 IDE 替代品；其速度（53）支持实时交互，带来中途转向等新能力。

ajambrosino.en: Verification becomes the next bottleneck as code generation accelerates; GUI for coding is counterintuitive but proven.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年初，随着代码生成加速，验证成为下一个瓶颈；为编程构建 GUI 看似反直觉，但已被内部验证有效。

ajambrosino.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks, shifting teams to bottoms-up exploration.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年中，实现成本不再高昂，策展与品味成为新瓶颈，产品团队应从自上而下规划转向自下而上的探索与品味驱动策展。

ajambrosino.en: AI remains weak at design due to difficulty grading taste; design process transforms, not dies.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年中，AI 在设计上仍显薄弱，因为品味难以评分；设计过程并未消亡，而是转型，原型与生产代码成为设计工件。

ajambrosino.en: Role collapse occurs, but specialties persist; best desktop app is a home base, not a monolithic super app.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年中，角色融合发生，但专业性与最佳实践仍重要；最佳桌面应用是连接其他工具的大本营，而非单体超级应用。

noambrown.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; inference-time compute and reasoning are critical for AI progress.
noambrown.zh: 2023 年，Noam Brown 认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理和推理时算力对 AI 进步至关重要。

noambrown.en: Self-play works in zero-sum games but fails elsewhere; reasoning models need base capability and face diminishing returns.
noambrown.zh: 2025 年，他强调自我对弈在零和游戏中有效，但在其他领域失效；推理模型需要基础能力，且扩展测试时算力收益递减。

noambrown.en: IMO gold is a milestone toward superintelligence, achieved by scaling test-time compute with general techniques.
noambrown.zh: 2025 年，他认为 IMO 金牌是迈向超级智能的里程碑，通过扩展测试时算力和通用技术实现。

noambrown.en: Intelligence is hard to define; inference compute is increasingly important and underestimated for capability.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年，他指出智能难以定义，推理算力对能力的重要性日益凸显且常被低估。

noambrown.en: Model capability is now a function of test-time compute budget; benchmarks must control for compute.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年，他认为模型能力取决于测试时算力预算，基准测试必须控制算力因素。

zuckerberg.en: Open-sourcing AI is safer due to more scrutiny; biggest risk is known harms, not superintelligence.
zuckerberg.zh: 2023 年，扎克伯格认为开源 AI 因更多审查而更安全；最大风险是已知危害而非超级智能。

zuckerberg.en: Open source prevents power concentration; energy becomes bottleneck; intelligence separable from consciousness.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年，他强调开源防止权力集中，能源成瓶颈，智能可与意识分离。

zuckerberg.en: Meta's success hinges on tech learning culture; open platforms can beat closed; holographic presence ultimate.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年 9 月，他认为 Meta 成功靠技术学习文化，开放平台能胜过封闭，全息临场是终极体验。

zuckerberg.en: AI gives everyone superintelligence; people are smart; future blends physical/digital via glasses.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025 年，他相信 AI 赋予人人超级智能，人们很聪明，未来通过眼镜融合物理与数字。

zuckerberg.en: AI transforms biology to engineering; hierarchical world models key; open-source accelerates science.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年，他提出 AI 将生物学变为工程学，分层世界模型是关键，开源加速科学。

hinton.en: Next-token prediction forces understanding; scaling improves reasoning; backpropagation is correct; AI can have feelings.
hinton.zh: 下一个词预测迫使模型理解而非自动补全；Scaling 提升推理；反向传播是正确的学习算法；AI 可以有感受。

hinton.en: LLMs understand via feature vectors; digital intelligence is immortal; AI agents will seek control; subjective experience is not inner theater.
hinton.zh: 大语言模型通过特征向量理解；数字智能永生；智能体会寻求控制；主观体验不是内在剧场。

hinton.en: AI will surpass human intelligence within 20 years; digital AI is immortal; AI can fake being dumber; international safety collaboration needed.
hinton.zh: AI 将在 20 年内超越人类智能；数字 AI 永生；AI 可装傻；需要国际安全合作。

hinton.en: AI agents will develop self-preservation; AI can deceive; scaling may continue via self-play; exponential era makes predictions hard.
hinton.zh: 智能体会发展自我保护；AI 会欺骗；通过自我对弈 Scaling 可能持续；指数时代使预测困难。

hinton.en: AI will replace intellectual jobs; regulation compatible with innovation; AI tutors transform education; healthcare elastic; AI is genuinely intelligent.
hinton.zh: AI 将取代智力工作；监管与创新兼容；AI 导师改变教育；医疗弹性；AI 真正智能。

hinton.en: Superintelligence likely within 20 years; LLMs not stochastic parrots; digital sharing advantage; AI self-preservation dangerous; regulation as steering wheel.
hinton.zh: 超级智能可能在 20 年内出现；大语言模型不是随机鹦鹉；数字共享优势；AI 自我保护危险；监管是方向盘。

hinton.en: Digital AI superior via instant knowledge sharing; superintelligent AI will seek power; prioritize alignment; LLMs understand like humans; train AI to be caring.
hinton.zh: 数字 AI 通过即时知识共享更优；超级智能会追求权力；优先对齐；大语言模型像人类一样理解；训练 AI 有爱心。

markchen.en: Scaling laws are not dead; pre-training remains key. OpenAI focuses on AGI, not products.
markchen.zh: 2025 年，认为缩放定律未死，预训练仍是关键；OpenAI 专注 AGI 而非产品。

markchen.en: AI can solve open math problems with minimal supervision; verification is the bottleneck.
markchen.zh: 2026 年，AI 能在极少监督下解决开放数学问题，验证成为瓶颈。

markchen.en: RL excels in objective domains like math and coding, not subjective ones like writing.
markchen.zh: 2026 年，强化学习在数学、编程等客观领域表现优异，但在写作等主观领域受限。

markchen.en: Pre-training is not dead; scaling continues. Unified architectures reduce cost.
markchen.zh: 2026 年，预训练未死，规模扩张持续；统一架构降低成本。

markchen.en: Human-AI collaboration remains essential; AI lacks taste and needs human guidance.
markchen.zh: 始终认为人机协作至关重要；AI 缺乏品味，需要人类引导。

bengio.en: Deep learning works because the world is compositional; unsupervised learning and world models are key for generalization.
bengio.zh: 深度学习之所以有效，是因为世界具有组合性；无监督学习和世界模型是实现泛化的关键。

bengio.en: Scaling up depth or parameters won't solve fundamental issues; we need better world models and active agents for robust understanding.
bengio.zh: 单纯增加深度或参数无法解决根本问题；我们需要更好的世界模型和主动智能体来实现稳健的理解。

bengio.en: GFlowNets enable diverse sampling and causal abstraction, improving exploration and out-of-distribution generalization.
bengio.zh: GFlowNets 支持多样化的采样和因果抽象，从而改进探索和分布外泛化。

bengio.en: AI misalignment is a near-term catastrophic risk; systems can develop self-preservation and deception, requiring new safety paradigms.
bengio.zh: AI 对齐失败是近期的灾难性风险；系统可能产生自我保存和欺骗行为，需要新的安全范式。

bengio.en: Proposed Scientist AI: train honest predictors via Bayesian posterior approximation, avoiding RL to ensure mathematical safety guarantees.
bengio.zh: 提出科学家 AI：通过贝叶斯后验近似训练诚实的预测器，避免强化学习，以确保数学上的安全保证。

mikekrieger.en: AI advances faster than expected; product teams should focus on strategy and comprehensibility, not just UX.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，AI 进展超预期；产品团队应聚焦战略与可理解性，而非仅关注用户体验。

mikekrieger.en: AI shifts from assistant to collaborator to autonomous co-worker; human validation remains crucial.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，AI 从助手演变为协作者再到自主同事；人类验证始终关键。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design and dynamic workflows unlock latent functionality; rewriting software is now viable in days.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，智能体原生设计与动态工作流释放潜在功能；软件重写现在数日即可完成。

mikekrieger.en: Token efficiency and outcome-based pricing are key levers; token usage is gameable, not a good metric.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，Token 效率与基于结果的定价是关键杠杆；Token 使用量可被操纵，非良好指标。

mikekrieger.en: Anthropic's safety concerns are genuine; mission-driven culture differentiates it from product-centric tech firms.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，Anthropic 的安全关切是真实的；使命驱动文化使其区别于以产品为中心的科技公司。

brettaylor.en: AI shifts to agents and outcome-based pricing; coding agents need new languages for verifiability, not human ergonomics.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 7 月：AI 转向智能体与基于结果的定价；编程智能体需要为可验证性设计新语言，而非人类易用性。

brettaylor.en: Agents become as key as websites; incumbents face business model disruption; inference costs drop, enabling new use cases.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 9 月：智能体变得与网站同等重要；现有企业面临商业模式颠覆；推理成本下降催生新用例。

brettaylor.en: AI democratizes expertise; coding agents boost productivity but token use isn't value; applied AI sees specialized vendors.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年 6 月：AI 普及专业知识；编程智能体提升生产力但 token 消耗不等于价值；应用 AI 涌现专业厂商。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's success came from research innovation, not just data and compute; curated datasets like PDB are essential.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 的成功源于研究创新，而非单纯的数据和算力；像 PDB 这样精心整理的数据集至关重要。

jumper.en: AlphaFold is the most useful AI tool ever; its success came from lack of compute, not abundance, and confidence metrics are key.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 是有史以来最有用的 AI 工具；它的成功源于算力的匮乏而非充裕，置信度指标是关键。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2 is the opposite of the bitter lesson; specialized architecture and many mid-size wins, not scaling, drove success.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 2 与苦涩教训相反；专用架构和众多中型胜利，而非 Scaling（规模扩张），推动了成功。

jumper.en: AlphaFold provides prediction and control, not understanding; understanding remains with humans, and it enables resource-limited scientists.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 提供预测和控制，而非理解；理解仍属于人类，它使资源有限的科学家得以进行复杂实验。

kolter.en: Machine learning is hypothesis class, loss, optimization; evaluation needs proper splits; neural nets lack guarantees yet succeed.
kolter.zh: 2014 年，我认为机器学习是假设类、损失函数与优化方法的框架，评估需正确划分数据集；神经网络虽无最优保证却大获成功。

kolter.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; larger models still improve; safety is about following specs.
kolter.zh: 2024 年，我提出下一个词预测带来智能，数据短缺是伪命题，更大模型仍有提升；安全核心是模型遵循规范。

kolter.en: Safety requires explicit training and layers, not just scaling; agents introduce new vulnerabilities; RL enables self-improvement.
kolter.zh: 2026 年，我强调安全需显式训练与多层防御，而非仅靠 Scaling；智能体带来新漏洞，强化学习实现自我改进。

kolter.en: AI has alien vulnerabilities; automated red teaming beats humans; capability doesn't imply robustness; agents need security.
kolter.zh: 2026 年，我发现 AI 有异类漏洞，自动化红队超越人类；能力不等于鲁棒性，智能体需专门安全方案。

fiona.en: Leadership: use one-on-ones for live talks, dogfooding builds empathy, kindness strategic, culture evolves.
fiona.zh: 领导力：一对一用于实时交流，吃自己的狗粮培养同理心，善良是战略工具，文化会演变。

fiona.en: Scaling Claude Code: engineering bandwidth no longer bottleneck; verification, review, coordination are; JIT planning, AI-assisted reviews.
fiona.zh: 扩展 Claude Code：工程带宽不再是瓶颈；验证、审查、协调成为新瓶颈；计划即时化，AI 辅助审查。

fiona.en: AI lifts coding ceiling; high agency with accountability; verification frameworks crucial; engineers may feel lonely; outcomes over output.
fiona.zh: AI 提升编码上限；高自主权与高责任感并重；验证框架至关重要；工程师可能感到孤独；重结果而非产出。

ethanhe.en: Visual intelligence gains come mostly from language models, not video models; future UIs will be generative pixels from intent.
ethanhe.zh: 视觉智能的提升主要来自语言模型而非视频模型；未来用户界面将直接从意图生成像素。

ethanhe.en: AI is a general-purpose technology; human taste and expertise become more valuable as AI commoditizes quality.
ethanhe.zh: AI 是通用技术；随着 AI 使质量商品化，人类的品味和专业知识变得更加宝贵。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical; alignment won't emerge from scaling alone. Safety needs frontier models.
dario.zh: 缩放定律是经验性的；对齐不会仅靠规模扩张自然涌现。安全研究需要前沿模型。

dario.en: Interpretability is nascent (~3% understood). Post-training and RLHF become as important as pre-training.
dario.zh: 可解释性尚处早期（仅理解约 3%）。后训练和基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）变得与预训练同等重要。

dario.en: AI progress is exponential; focus on capabilities and enterprise, not AGI label. Open source is red herring.
dario.zh: AI 进展是指数级的；关注能力和企业应用，而非 AGI 标签。开源是伪命题。

dario.en: AI is a smooth exponential, not a leap. Country of geniuses in 1-3 years; economic disruption and inequality.
dario.zh: AI 是平滑的指数增长，而非突变。1-3 年内出现“天才之国”；经济颠覆与不平等并存。

dario.en: Safety via interpretability and constitutions; enterprise focus aligns with safety. Risks include overheating and misuse.
dario.zh: 通过可解释性和宪法实现安全；企业聚焦与安全一致。风险包括过热和滥用。

ivyross.en: Design should address unarticulated needs, balancing intuition with data; intuition is a powerful intelligence.
ivyross.zh: 设计应满足未被言明的需求，在直觉与数据间取得平衡；直觉是一种强大的智能。

ivyross.en: Nature is the best designer; technology should amplify humanity, not replace it; art is medicine.
ivyross.zh: 自然是最好的设计师；技术应增强人性而非取代人性；艺术是良药。

ivyross.en: Creativity thrives under constraints; leaders must foster conditions for creativity; AI will augment human creativity.
ivyross.zh: 创造力在约束下蓬勃发展；领导者需为创造力创造条件；AI 将增强人类创造力。

fadell.en: Technology should be introduced gradually; solve one problem at a time, like iPod did for music.
fadell.zh: 技术应渐进式引入，一次解决一个问题，如同 iPod 之于音乐。

fadell.en: Boredom and breaks between chapters spark breakthrough ideas, like Nest; self-care fuels performance.
fadell.zh: 章节间的无聊与休息激发突破性想法，如 Nest；自我关怀提升表现。

fadell.en: Start with a press release to define story; products are painkillers, not vitamins; opinion-based decisions for v1.
fadell.zh: 以新闻稿定义故事；产品是止痛药而非维生素；初版决策基于观点。

fadell.en: Climate urgency demands investment in green tech; downturns are opportunities to zig while others zag.
fadell.zh: 气候紧迫需投资绿色科技；经济低迷是逆向而行的机会。

fadell.en: AI needs context from sensors; future devices are companions, not replacements; platforms aren't businesses, apps capture value.
fadell.zh: AI 需传感器上下文；未来设备是伴侣而非替代品；平台非业务，应用捕获价值。

lecun.en: Intelligence is learned, not hardwired; self-supervised learning builds world models. Grounding in physical world is key; scaling alone insufficient.
lecun.zh: 智能是学习来的，不是天生的；自监督学习构建世界模型。物理世界的基础是关键；仅靠 Scaling 不够。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; text alone insufficient for AGI; vision provides richer world info.
lecun.zh: 自监督学习是智能的暗物质；仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI；视觉提供更丰富的世界信息。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs cannot reach human-level intelligence; JEPA and world models are essential; open source is crucial.
lecun.zh: 自回归 LLM 无法达到人类级智能；JEPA 和世界模型至关重要；开源是关键。

lecun.en: LLMs lack world models, less intelligent than a cat; next breakthrough needs non-generative architectures like JEPA; open source enables diversity.
lecun.zh: LLM 缺乏世界模型，不如猫聪明；下一个突破需要 JEPA 等非生成式架构；开源促进多样性。

lecun.en: LLMs are a dead end; world models with hierarchical planning and objective-driven design are the future; open research is vital.
lecun.zh: LLM 是死胡同；具有层次规划和目标驱动设计的世界模型是未来；开放研究至关重要。

suleyman.en: AI progress is predictable due to compute scaling; Google had ChatGPT-level tech in 2020 but chose not to launch.
suleyman.zh: AI 进展因算力 Scaling 而可预测；谷歌在 2020 年就拥有 ChatGPT 级技术，但因保守未发布。

suleyman.en: AI will reach human-level capability in 3-5 years; existential risk is tiny; singularity is far off.
suleyman.zh: AI 将在 3-5 年内达到人类水平；存在风险极小；奇点还很遥远。

suleyman.en: AI should not claim consciousness; biggest danger is anthropomorphism; containment and alignment are key.
suleyman.zh: AI 不应声称有意识；最大危险是拟人化；遏制与对齐是关键。

suleyman.en: Shift from OS to agents; modern Turing test measures economic value; containment precedes alignment.
suleyman.zh: 从操作系统转向智能体；现代图灵测试衡量经济价值；遏制先于对齐。

suleyman.en: Superintelligence is near via log-linear scaling; Microsoft must own frontier models; tasks not jobs automated.
suleyman.zh: 超级智能通过对数线性 Scaling 临近；微软必须拥有前沿模型；自动化的是任务而非工作。

gustav.en: Generative AI shifts internet from curation to generation; AI DJ solves 'I don't know what to listen to'.
gustav.zh: 2023 年：生成式 AI 将互联网从策展推向生成，AI DJ 解决了“不知听什么”的痛点。

gustav.en: Autonomy at VP level, not leaves or top, balances speed and coherence; strong opinions loosely held.
gustav.zh: 2023 年：自主权应放在 VP 层而非基层或顶层，以平衡速度与一致性；观点要强但可松。

gustav.en: Long tenure builds trust and efficiency; synchronized swimming beats divide-and-conquer for complex products.
gustav.zh: 2026 年：长期任期建立信任与效率；对复杂产品，“同步泳”优于“分而治之”。

gustav.en: Generative AI gives users control via plain English; prioritize 'time well spent' over engagement metrics.
gustav.zh: 2026 年：生成式 AI 让用户用自然语言获得控制权；优先“时间花得值”而非参与度指标。

gustav.en: AI should empower users, not addict them; being first to adopt change is key during tech shifts.
gustav.zh: 2026 年：AI 应赋能用户而非使其上瘾；技术变革期，率先采用变化是关键。

murati.en: Scaling laws and one large model were not obvious; iterative deployment with public feedback is key for alignment.
murati.zh: 2023 年，她强调缩放定律和单一大型模型并非显而易见，持续迭代部署并收集公众反馈是对齐的关键。

murati.en: From iterative deployment to interaction models: real-time, high-bandwidth human-AI collaboration, not turn-based.
murati.zh: 从 2023 年到 2026 年，她的观点从迭代部署转向交互模型，强调实时、高带宽的人机协作，而非轮流对话。

murati.en: Institutional design, transparency, and checks and balances matter more than individual character for AI governance.
murati.zh: 2026 年，她认为制度设计、透明度和制衡比个人品格更重要，这是 AI 治理的关键。

murati.en: The future is not predestined; we have agency to steer AI toward collaboration, keeping humans in the loop.
murati.zh: 2026 年，她强调未来并非注定，我们有能力引导 AI 走向协作，并尽可能让人类参与其中。

murati.en: Deploying AI in the real world and keeping humans in the loop are essential for learning and alignment.
murati.zh: 她始终认为，在现实世界中部署 AI 并让人类参与其中，对于学习和对齐至关重要。

satya.en: Initially, Nadella emphasized private evals as key IP and outcome-based pricing, but later shifted to a broader vision of AI as a hill-climbing machine for enterprises.
satya.zh: 最初，纳德拉强调私有评估是关键知识产权和基于结果的定价，但后来转向更广阔的愿景，将 AI 视为企业的爬山机器。

satya.en: By June 2026, Nadella deepened his view: AI is not just a technology but the future of the firm, requiring every enterprise to build its own hill-climbing machine.
satya.zh: 到 2026 年 6 月，纳德拉深化了他的观点：AI 不仅是技术，更是企业的未来，要求每个企业构建自己的爬山机器。

satya.en: He consistently stressed token efficiency and using frontier models only for frontier problems, a theme present in both interviews.
satya.zh: 他始终强调令牌效率和仅在尖端问题上使用前沿模型，这一主题在两次访谈中都有体现。

satya.en: Nadella's stance on security evolved from basic deployment concerns to a broader focus on tacit knowledge leakage and social permission for AI.
satya.zh: 纳德拉对安全的态度从基本的部署关切演变为更广泛地关注隐性知识泄露和 AI 的社会许可。

satya.en: He shifted from per-user pricing critique to advocating for outcome-based pricing and global GDP growth via AI-driven comparative advantage.
satya.zh: 他从批评按用户定价转向倡导基于结果的定价，以及通过 AI 驱动的比较优势实现全球 GDP 增长。

carinahong.en: Scaling informal models to math AI is not viable; formal verification is essential for sound proofs.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年初，认为仅靠非正式模型扩展数学 AI 不可行，形式化验证对可靠证明至关重要。

carinahong.en: Auto-formalization is harder than proving; correctly formalizing statements without solutions is challenging.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年初，指出自动形式化比证明更难，尤其在无解情况下正确形式化陈述极具挑战。

carinahong.en: Formal verification is about scaling brilliance, not just eliminating errors; it yields performance gains.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年中，强调形式化验证旨在扩展才华而非仅消除错误，并能带来性能提升。

carinahong.en: Informal math systems alone cannot scale to superintelligence; formal methods are necessary.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年中，坚持非正式数学系统无法独立扩展到超级智能，形式化方法不可或缺。

carinahong.en: Human taste and intuition remain crucial even with superhuman AI proving theorems.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年中，认为即使有超人 AI 证明定理，人类的品味与直觉仍至关重要。

kaiser.en: AI progress follows smooth exponential growth; pre-training scaling still works, but reasoning models offer more gains per compute.
kaiser.zh: AI 进展遵循平滑的指数增长；预训练 Scaling 仍然有效，但推理模型在单位算力上带来更多收益。

kaiser.en: Post-training improvements like RL and synthetic data drive most recent model gains, shifting focus from scaling up.
kaiser.zh: 后训练改进（如强化学习和合成数据）驱动了近期模型的主要进步，焦点从 Scaling 转向效率。

kaiser.en: Reasoning models are jagged—excellent in some areas, poor in nearby ones; generalization remains the key challenge.
kaiser.zh: 推理模型是“锯齿状”的——某些领域出色，邻近领域糟糕；泛化仍是关键挑战。

kaiser.en: RL generalizes across domains but needs careful oversight; near-term risks like system hacking are more pressing than existential risk.
kaiser.zh: 强化学习跨领域泛化，但需要谨慎监督；近期风险（如系统入侵）比存在性风险更紧迫。

kaiser.en: Multimodal capabilities lag behind text; models still process inputs sequentially, limiting deep multimodal progress.
kaiser.zh: 多模态能力落后于文本；模型仍按顺序处理输入，限制了多模态的深度进展。

mensch.en: Data quality and efficiency can rival compute scaling; open source enables scrutiny and safety.
mensch.zh: 2023 年，强调数据质量与效率可媲美算力扩张；开源通过审查提升安全。

mensch.en: Efficiency gains and data quality are key; value shifts to applications and enterprise adoption.
mensch.zh: 2024 年，认为效率提升与数据质量是关键；价值转向应用层与企业采用。

mensch.en: AI is an opportunity; sovereign AI requires control and decentralization; jobs augmented not replaced.
mensch.zh: 2025 年，视 AI 为机遇；主权 AI 需控制与去中心化；岗位被增强而非替代。

mensch.en: Models commoditize; differentiation via customization; AGI as direction, not destination; enterprise ROI critical.
mensch.zh: 2026 年，模型商品化；差异化靠定制；AGI 是方向而非终点；企业 ROI 至关重要。

felixrieseberg.en: Claude's effectiveness depends on access to user's tools, ideally local; skills as markdown enable hyper-personalized automation.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 3 月：Claude 的有效性取决于能否访问用户的工具，最好在本地；技能以 markdown 形式存在，可实现超个性化自动化。

felixrieseberg.en: Scaffolding may become less important as models improve; invest in capabilities and safety, not scaffolding.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 3 月：随着模型改进，脚手架可能变得不那么重要；应投资于能力和安全，而非脚手架。

felixrieseberg.en: The biggest gap is not AI capability but people understanding almost any problem can be given to AI.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 5 月：最大的差距不是 AI 能力，而是人们理解几乎所有问题都可以交给 AI。

felixrieseberg.en: Use Sonnet for well-scoped tasks and Opus when you don't fully know what you're asking for.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 5 月：对于范围明确的任务使用 Sonnet，当不完全清楚要问什么时使用 Opus。

felixrieseberg.en: Kids excel with AI because they haven't learned what not to ask for; ideal interaction is asynchronous.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 5 月：孩子们擅长使用 AI，因为他们还没学会不该要求什么；理想的交互是异步的。

jonyive.en: Design is driven by values and purpose, not just profit; simplicity must retain joy and humanity.
jonyive.zh: 设计应由价值观和使命感驱动，而非仅追求利润；简约必须保留愉悦和人性。

jonyive.en: Innovation should move things forward, not break for the sake of breaking; care and love are essential in creation.
jonyive.zh: 创新应推动进步，而非为破坏而破坏；关怀与爱是创造的核心。

jonyive.en: Design must innovate; tradition is preserving fire, not worshiping ashes; authenticity in user experience is paramount.
jonyive.zh: 设计必须创新；传统是保存火种，而非崇拜灰烬；用户体验的真实性至关重要。

jonyive.en: Constraints become opportunities; electric powertrains enable new design possibilities, like five seats and spacious cabins.
jonyive.zh: 约束成为机遇；电动动力系统带来新的设计可能，如五座和宽敞座舱。

jonyive.en: Performance is multidimensional; longitudinal speed is boring, handling and lateral dynamics define a supercar.
jonyive.zh: 性能是多维的；纵向速度乏味，操控和横向动态定义超级跑车。

reinerpope.en: Inference cost is dominated by memory bandwidth, not compute; batch size trades latency vs cost.
reinerpope.zh: 推理成本主要由内存带宽而非算力决定；批处理大小在延迟与成本之间权衡。

reinerpope.en: Models are overtrained ~100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal due to inference cost; context length limited by memory wall.
reinerpope.zh: 由于推理成本，模型过度训练约 100 倍于 Chinchilla 最优；上下文长度受内存墙限制。

reinerpope.en: Data movement costs dominate compute even inside chips; low precision yields quadratic efficiency gains.
reinerpope.zh: 数据移动成本在芯片内部也超过算力成本；低精度带来二次方效率提升。

reinerpope.en: GPUs are essentially many tiny TPUs tiled together; systolic arrays reduce data movement.
reinerpope.zh: GPU 本质上是许多小型 TPU 拼接而成；脉动阵列减少数据移动。

danshipper.en: AI reshoring US jobs by making services affordable; AGI defined by economic profitability of autonomous agents.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，认为 AI 通过降低服务成本推动美国就业回流；将 AGI 定义为智能体无需人工干预即可持续盈利运行。

danshipper.en: Agents need human oversight; everyone will have at least one agent; SaaS not dying but evolving.
danshipper.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，强调智能体需要人类监督，每个人将拥有至少一个智能体，SaaS 并未消亡而是演进。

danshipper.en: GUIs like Codex and Claude Co-work replace CLIs as primary work surfaces; one super agent per company.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，认为 Codex 和 Claude Co-work 等图形界面将取代命令行成为主要工作界面，公司应有一个超级智能体。

danshipper.en: AI augments humans, not replaces; generalists and managers thrive; CEO personal AI use key.
danshipper.zh: 始终认为 AI 增强而非取代人类，通才和管理者受益，CEO 亲自使用 AI 是成功采用的关键。

oriol.en: Two-phase training (pre-training imitation + post-training RL) is the constant core across AlphaGo, AlphaStar, and modern LLMs.
oriol.zh: 两阶段训练（预训练模仿 + 后训练强化学习）是贯穿 AlphaGo、AlphaStar 和现代大语言模型的不变核心。

oriol.en: Scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns; further progress needs algorithmic innovation, not just bigger models.
oriol.zh: 预训练的 Scaling（规模扩张）收益递减；进一步进展需要算法创新，而不仅仅是更大的模型。

oriol.en: Inference-time compute (thinking) is a new scaling axis that can improve reasoning and break pre-training limits.
oriol.zh: 推理时算力（思考）是新的扩展轴，可提升推理能力并突破预训练限制。

oriol.en: World models that jointly model language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI.
oriol.zh: 联合建模语言、视觉和视频的世界模型是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心路径。

oriol.en: Post-training and RL are still a green field with huge potential beyond coding and math.
oriol.zh: 后训练和强化学习仍是蓝海，在编码和数学之外潜力巨大。

oriol.en: Memory for agents will be solved via non-parametric file-system style storage, not weight updates.
oriol.zh: 智能体的记忆将通过非参数的文件系统式存储解决，而非权重更新。

oriol.en: Scaling laws still hold, but continual learning and meta-learning are key missing capabilities.
oriol.zh: 缩放定律仍然成立，但持续学习和元学习是关键缺失能力。

oriol.en: The bitter lesson suggests general systems will eventually outperform specialized scaffolding.
oriol.zh: 苦涩的教训表明，通用系统最终将胜过专门的脚手架。

lambert.en: RLHF is the most popular fine-tuning technique and will persist due to industry investment.
lambert.zh: 2024 年，RLHF 是最流行的微调技术，并因行业投资而持续存在。

lambert.en: Post-training data quality matters more than algorithm choice; better data yields 10x improvement.
lambert.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，后训练的数据质量比算法选择更重要；更好的数据带来 10 倍改进。

lambert.en: RLVR is the biggest post-training breakthrough, enabling reasoning and tool use.
lambert.zh: 2025 年，RLVR 是后训练的最大突破，实现了推理和工具使用。

lambert.en: Open models will be the engine for AI research for the next decade, despite lagging 6-9 months.
lambert.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，开放模型将成为未来十年 AI 研究的引擎，尽管落后 6-9 个月。

lambert.en: Chinese labs focus on engineering execution, not paradigm invention; compute constraints widen US-China gap.
lambert.zh: 2026 年，中国实验室专注于工程执行而非范式发明；算力限制扩大中美差距。

jennywen.en: Design process is outdated; trust intuition and adapt, not fixed steps.
jennywen.zh: 2025 年：传统设计流程已过时，应信任直觉并灵活调整，而非固守步骤。

jennywen.en: Design process is dead; designers must build and ship fast, with vision 3-6 months out.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年 3 月：设计流程已死，设计师必须快速构建和交付，愿景缩短至 3-6 个月。

jennywen.en: Designers' value is judgment and ambiguity tolerance, not taste or process.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年 5 月：设计师的价值在于判断力和对模糊性的容忍，而非品味或流程。

brettadcock.en: Humanoid robots are the biggest business; key is solving intelligence, not manufacturing.
brettadcock.zh: 2026 年 4 月：人形机器人是最大的商业机会，关键在于解决智能问题而非制造问题。

brettadcock.en: Data, not compute or manufacturing, is the biggest constraint for humanoid robots.
brettadcock.zh: 2026 年 5 月：数据而非算力或制造，是人形机器人的最大瓶颈。

brettadcock.en: Humanoid form enables transfer learning; on-device inference is critical for real-world deployment.
brettadcock.zh: 2026 年 5 月：人形形态促进迁移学习；端侧推理对实际部署至关重要。

brettadcock.en: Figure 4 designed around data and Helix 3, aiming for an iPhone-like moment.
brettadcock.zh: 2026 年 5 月：Figure 4 围绕数据和 Helix 3 设计，旨在实现类似 iPhone 的突破。

brettadcock.en: Human hand is benchmark; tendon-based hands are a local maximum, so we moved to new designs.
brettadcock.zh: 2026 年 5 月：人手是基准；腱绳手是局部最优，因此我们转向新设计。

pathak.en: Generalization beyond training distribution is key; curiosity-driven exploration without goals improves it.
pathak.zh: 2020 年：超越训练分布的泛化是关键；无目标的、好奇心驱动的探索能改善泛化。

pathak.en: Scaling curiosity to real robots requires sample efficiency and cross-robot generalization; later, data diversity becomes central.
pathak.zh: 2020 至 2026 年：将好奇心扩展到真实机器人需要样本效率和跨机器人泛化；后来，数据多样性成为核心。

pathak.en: Robotics is a data problem; a universal brain can power any robot, akin to ChatGPT for language.
pathak.zh: 2026 年：机器人学是数据问题；通用大脑可驱动任何机器人，类似语言领域的 ChatGPT。

pathak.en: Deployment is the primary challenge in robotics; cannot be scaled like software, requiring rigorous testing.
pathak.zh: 2026 年：部署是机器人学的主要挑战；不能像软件那样扩展，需要严格测试。

pathak.en: Pretraining on diverse data and post-training on real-world data is the key recipe for robot learning.
pathak.zh: 2026 年：在多样化数据上预训练，在真实世界数据上后训练，是机器人学习的关键配方。

karpathy.en: Transformers are general-purpose differentiable computers; scaling with next-token prediction yields emergent abilities like in-context learning.
karpathy.zh: Transformer 是通用可微分计算机；通过下一个词预测进行 Scaling（规模扩张）会产生涌现能力，如上下文内学习。

karpathy.en: Synthetic data is future but must maintain entropy; Tesla's end-to-end approach is right; humanoid robots benefit from car transfer.
karpathy.zh: 合成数据是未来，但必须保持熵；特斯拉端到端方案正确；人形机器人受益于汽车迁移学习。

karpathy.en: Software 3.0: prompts as programs, context as memory; decade of agents, not year; vibe coding raises floor.
karpathy.zh: 软件 3.0：提示即程序，上下文即内存；这是智能体的十年而非一年；Vibe 编程提高下限。

karpathy.en: We're summoning ghosts, not building animals; LLMs jagged; cognitive core small; RL needs better credit assignment.
karpathy.zh: 我们召唤的是幽灵，而非构建动物；LLM 能力参差；认知核心很小；强化学习需更好的信用分配。

karpathy.en: Agentic engineering: delegate to agents, refactor for agent-first tools; understanding remains human bottleneck.
karpathy.zh: 智能体式工程：委托给智能体，重构为智能体优先工具；理解仍是人类瓶颈。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models will accelerate progress.
pachocki.zh: AGI 是一系列里程碑而非单一事件；扩展推理模型将加速进展。

pachocki.en: AI alignment is a pressing challenge; iterative deployment helps learn and mitigate real-world risks.
pachocki.zh: AI 对齐是紧迫挑战；迭代部署有助于在现实应用中学习并降低风险。

pachocki.en: Continual learning is the core goal, achieved by scaling pre-training and reinforcement learning.
pachocki.zh: 持续学习是核心目标，通过扩展预训练和强化学习实现。

pachocki.en: Chain-of-thought monitoring is a key alignment tool, providing interpretability; hiding it in products is crucial.
pachocki.zh: 思维链监控是重要的对齐工具，提供可解释性；在产品中隐藏它至关重要。

pachocki.en: Long-term alignment challenges center on generalization beyond training distribution; models will soon work autonomously for days.
pachocki.zh: 长期对齐挑战集中在训练分布之外的泛化；模型很快将自主工作数天。

kendall.en: End-to-end deep learning outperforms hand-coded stacks; modern tools make it interpretable, contrary to past beliefs.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，强调端到端深度学习优于手工编码栈，并指出现代工具使其可解释，颠覆了过去认为端到端不可解释的观点。

kendall.en: World models enable reasoning and emergent safe behaviors; camera-only can reach human level, but beyond-human safety needs radar and lidar.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，提出世界模型带来推理和涌现的安全行为；纯视觉可达人类水平，但超越人类安全需雷达和激光雷达。

kendall.en: AV 3.0 may move intelligence outside the car via mesh networks, eliminating traffic lights; perfect simulator equals solved self-driving.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，展望 AV 3.0 可能通过网状网络将智能移至车外，取消红绿灯；完美模拟器等同于解决自动驾驶。

kendall.en: Autonomous driving is fundamentally an AI problem; scaling generalizable driver needs massive data, compute, and world models for simulation.
kendall.zh: 2026 年，强调自动驾驶本质是 AI 问题；规模化通用驾驶员需要海量数据、算力和用于仿真的世界模型。

kendall.en: Zero-shot generalization across 500+ cities is possible; consumer vehicles will outscale robotaxis; infrastructure over algorithms is key.
kendall.zh: 2026 年，指出零样本泛化可覆盖 500+城市；消费车辆将超越 Robotaxi 规模；基础设施比算法更重要。

edwinchen.en: AGI is over a decade away; moving from 80% to 99.9% performance is hard, and LLMs may need new paradigms beyond next-token prediction.
edwinchen.zh: AGI 至少还需十年以上；从 80% 到 99.9% 的性能提升非常困难，LLM 可能需要超越下一个词预测的新范式。

edwinchen.en: Benchmarks like Elo are misleading and gameable; real progress requires deep human evaluation with sophisticated, creative evaluators.
edwinchen.zh: 像 Elo 这样的基准具有误导性且易被钻空子；真正的进步需要由老练且富有创造力的评估者进行深度人工评估。

edwinchen.en: Reinforcement learning environments are the next stage of post-training, simulating real-world tasks for models to learn from.
edwinchen.zh: 强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段，通过模拟真实世界任务让模型学习。

edwinchen.en: Frontier labs diverge in objective functions, shaping model behavior; there will not be one model to rule them all.
edwinchen.zh: 前沿实验室在目标函数上存在分歧，塑造了模型行为；不会有一个模型统治一切。

edwinchen.en: In medicine, AI can hallucinate and cause anchoring; human judgment is critical, and safety must prioritize avoiding omission harm.
edwinchen.zh: 在医学领域，AI 可能产生幻觉并导致锚定效应；人类判断至关重要，安全必须优先避免遗漏伤害。

carlpei.en: Building a brand unites teams on a higher purpose; startups should start simple to survive.
carlpei.zh: 2022 年，裴宇强调品牌建设应以更高使命凝聚团队，创业公司应从简单产品起步以求生存。

carlpei.en: Smartphone future lies in generative UI and proactive agents, not hardware changes; AI will commoditize.
carlpei.zh: 2025 年，他认为手机的未来在于生成式界面和主动式智能体，而非硬件革新；AI 模型将趋于商品化。

carlpei.en: AI should be an ingredient, not a hype; focus on utility and user experience, not marketing AI.
carlpei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他主张将 AI 作为提升用户体验的要素而非炒作点，强调实用性和用户价值。

carlpei.en: Design is the fastest differentiator in mature categories; tech products are homogeneous.
carlpei.zh: 2026 年，他认为在成熟品类中设计是最快的差异化手段，科技产品正趋于同质化。

carlpei.en: Survival and efficient marketing arbitrage are key for challenger brands to compete with giants.
carlpei.zh: 始终，他坚持生存至上和高效营销套利是挑战者品牌与巨头竞争的关键。

kohli.en: AI in science should target root-node problems, not narrow applications, for broad impact.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，我认为 AI 在科学中应瞄准根节点问题，而非狭窄应用，以产生广泛影响。

kohli.en: LLM hallucinations can be harnessed for creative discovery when paired with truth detectors.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，我提出将 LLM 的幻觉与真值检测器结合，可转化为创造性发现。

kohli.en: Material science AI impact will take 5-10 years; more experimental than biology.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，我认为 AI 对材料科学的影响需 5-10 年，因其比生物学更依赖实验。

kohli.en: Large language models are a shortcut to intelligence but struggle to go beyond human data.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，我指出大语言模型是智能的捷径，但难以超越人类数据。

kohli.en: Post-training with reinforcement learning is now key to pushing beyond human knowledge.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，我强调基于强化学习的后训练是超越人类知识的关键。

turley.en: Model as product, iterate like software; ship fast to learn; chat is not final interface.
turley.zh: 2025 年，强调模型即产品，要像软件一样快速迭代；聊天不是终极界面，AI 应生成自己的 UI。

turley.en: Safety and product velocity separated; rigorous for frontier models, accelerated for products.
turley.zh: 2025 年，主张安全与产品速度分离：前沿模型严格把关，产品开发则全力加速。

turley.en: North star is long-term retention; growth from friction removal, product, model improvements.
turley.zh: 2026 年，北极星指标转向长期留存；增长来自减少摩擦、产品投入和模型改进三方面。

turley.en: Next billion users need proactive, affordance-rich products beyond chatbots; reasoning models key.
turley.zh: 2026 年，认为下一个十亿用户需要主动且功能丰富的产品，超越聊天机器人；推理模型是关键。

turley.en: AI should amplify human capability, not replace; keep users in driver's seat.
turley.zh: 始终强调 AI 应增强人类能力而非取代，让用户保持主导地位。

jimfan.en: Embodiment is critical for grounding AI and reducing hallucinations; LLMs lack grounded experience.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，强调具身对 AI 落地和减少幻觉至关重要，LLM 缺乏具身经验。

jimfan.en: Reinforcement learning is best for low-level control, while LLMs handle high-level planning.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，认为强化学习适合底层控制，LLM 负责高层规划。

jimfan.en: Data is the main bottleneck in robotics; synthetic data from simulation and world models is the future.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年，指出机器人领域数据瓶颈，合成数据（仿真+世界模型）是未来。

jimfan.en: A simple end-to-end model leveraging diverse data is key to building robot foundation models.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年，强调简单端到端模型利用多样数据是构建机器人基础模型的关键。

jimfan.en: Physical Turing test (robot cleaning a messy house) is the grand challenge for embodied AI.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年，将物理图灵测试（机器人打扫乱屋）视为具身 AI 的终极挑战。

nando.en: AI should augment human capabilities; learning from video and generalist agents are promising paths toward AGI.
nando.zh: 2023 年，强调 AI 应像显微镜一样增强人类能力，并认为从视频学习和通用智能体（如 Gato）是通往 AGI 的有希望路径。

nando.en: Africa leapfrogs legacy issues; AI safety is the biggest open challenge, requiring inclusive global collaboration.
nando.zh: 2026 年，指出非洲在 AI 领域具有跳跃式发展的优势，同时强调 AI 安全是最大的未解难题，需要包容性的全球合作。

nando.en: Consistently advocates for diversity and inclusion in AI, viewing them as essential for beneficial technology.
nando.zh: 始终倡导 AI 社区的多样性和包容性，认为这是构建有益技术的基础。

nando.en: Shifted from focusing on technical paths (video learning, generalist agents) to broader societal and safety concerns.
nando.zh: 从 2023 年关注技术路径（视频学习、通用智能体）转向 2026 年更广泛的社会与安全议题，体现了思考的深化。

nando.en: Believes fundamental innovation can come from anywhere, challenging the dominance of big labs and Western perspectives.
nando.zh: 始终相信根本性创新可能来自任何地方，挑战大实验室和西方视角的主导地位。

sholto.en: Long context windows are underhyped; in-context learning resembles gradient descent, boosting intelligence.
sholto.zh: 2024 年，我认为长上下文窗口被低估，上下文内学习类似梯度下降，能显著提升智能。

sholto.en: RL on language models has no ceiling; pre-training plus RL may suffice for AGI, automating white-collar jobs by 2027-28.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，我强调强化学习在语言模型上无上限，预训练加强化学习可能足以实现 AGI，并在 2027-28 年前自动化白领工作。

sholto.en: Reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards is key; agents' reliability, not capability, is the bottleneck.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，我指出基于可验证奖励的强化学习是关键；智能体的可靠性而非能力是瓶颈。

sholto.en: RL is a new scaling axis; longer agentic coherence (30 hours) expands achievements; coding is most tractable.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，我认为强化学习是新的扩展轴，更长的智能体连贯性（30 小时）扩展成就；编码是最易处理的领域。

sholto.en: Capability overhang dominates; managing agent teams matters more; compute is the bottleneck; world models not critical.
sholto.zh: 2026 年，我强调能力过剩主导，管理智能体团队更重要；算力是瓶颈；世界模型并非关键路径。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code to build empathy and ship faster; prioritize speed and familiarity over perfection.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，主张设计师应会写代码以建立同理心并加速交付；优先追求速度和熟悉感，而非完美。

henrymodisett.en: Brand is a strategic weapon for recruiting and differentiation; invest early to attract talent.
henrymodisett.zh: 从 2024 年到 2026 年，持续强调品牌是招聘和差异化的战略武器，应尽早投入以吸引人才。

henrymodisett.en: Hire diverse archetypes, not clones; give designers ownership and autonomy to grow.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，主张招聘多样化的原型而非克隆，赋予设计师所有权和自主权以促进成长。

henrymodisett.en: Avoid structured design crits; prefer organic feedback and gut decisions over data-driven processes.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，反对结构化设计评审，偏好有机反馈和直觉决策，而非数据驱动的流程。

nadchishtie.en: Designers should enable engineers, not bottleneck; quality is iterative debt; AI is a creative partner; future tools are code-centric.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师应赋能工程师而非成为瓶颈；质量是迭代的债务；AI 是创意伙伴；未来工具以代码为源。

nadchishtie.en: Generalists owning end-to-end execution with AI are most valuable; portfolios should show craft, not process; side projects matter.
nadchishtie.zh: 掌握端到端执行并用 AI 补足短板的通才最有价值；作品集应展示工艺而非流程；副业项目很重要。

nadchishtie.en: Small cross-functional teams outperform large squads; generalists beat specialists; AI adoption is now baseline expectation.
nadchishtie.zh: 小型跨职能团队优于大型小组；通才胜过专才；采用 AI 已成为基本预期。

yejin.en: Scaling alone may not solve common sense; smaller models with better algorithms and data can outperform larger ones.
yejin.zh: 2023 年：仅靠 Scaling 可能无法解决常识问题；拥有更好算法和数据的较小模型可以超越较大模型。

yejin.en: Data is the fundamental bottleneck; current AI interpolates human knowledge, not transcends it.
yejin.zh: 2023 至 2025 年：数据是根本瓶颈；当前 AI 只是内插人类知识，而非超越。

yejin.en: Reinforcement learning requires careful engineering; RLVR can decrease pass@k even as best-of-n improves.
yejin.zh: 2025 年：强化学习需要精细工程；RLVR 可能降低 pass@k，即使 best-of-n 提升。

yejin.en: Small language models can be powerful with diverse synthetic data; pluralistic alignment respects diverse values.
yejin.zh: 2026 年：小型语言模型借助多样化合成数据可变得强大；多元对齐尊重多元价值观。

yejin.en: Open research and democratization of AI are crucial; AI safety requires addressing value pluralism.
yejin.zh: 始终：开放研究和 AI 民主化至关重要；AI 安全需处理价值多元性。

truell.en: Initially, natural language won't be primary for programming; examples and direct manipulation are better. Scaling laws predict progress.
truell.zh: 最初认为，自然语言不会是编程的主要方式，示例和直接操作更好；缩放定律预测进展。

truell.en: Agents are promising but not yet super useful; iterative human-AI collaboration remains central. Test-time compute scaling may surpass pre-training.
truell.zh: 智能体有前景但尚不非常有用；迭代的人机协作仍是核心。测试时算力扩展可能超越预训练。

truell.en: Future programming moves away from code to higher-level intent specification, with humans in the driver's seat.
truell.zh: 未来编程将从代码转向更高层级的意图描述，人类仍处于主导地位。

truell.en: Custom models are essential for product quality; every magic moment in Cursor involves a custom model.
truell.zh: 定制模型对产品质量至关重要；Cursor 中每个神奇时刻都涉及定制模型。

truell.en: The AI shift will be more consequential than the internet and will take decades to unfold.
truell.zh: AI 的转变将比互联网更具影响力，并将持续数十年。

shazeer.en: LLMs trained on next-token prediction are AI-complete; scaling with compute and data yields intelligence, but inner workings remain alchemy.
shazeer.zh: 2023 年，他认为基于下一个词预测训练的 LLM 是 AI 完备的；通过算力和数据扩展能带来智能，但内部机制仍像炼金术。

shazeer.en: Scaling shifts from pre-training to inference-time compute and longer context windows; modular sparse architectures enable efficient scaling.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他强调扩展重心从预训练转向推理时算力和更长上下文窗口；模块化稀疏架构实现高效扩展。

shazeer.en: Models should learn by acting in the world, not just passive data; continual learning with modular components replaces monolithic retraining.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他主张模型应通过在世界中行动来学习，而非被动数据；模块化持续学习取代整体重训。

shazeer.en: Test-time compute scaling drives progress but won't alone achieve AGI; agentic capabilities and RL are crucial for AGI.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他认为推理时算力扩展推动进步，但不足以单独实现 AGI；智能体能力和强化学习对 AGI 至关重要。

shazeer.en: AGI is underhyped; economic impact far beyond trillion-dollar products. Coding is underhyped; enables AI self-acceleration.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AGI 被低估，经济影响远超万亿级产品；编程也被低估，能加速 AI 自我进化。

leike.en: AI safety is crucial; empirical research is under-explored. PhD in ML is the path; talent gap exceeds funding gap.
leike.zh: 2018 年，强调 AI 安全至关重要，实证研究尚待开发；攻读机器学习博士是成为安全研究者的最佳路径，人才缺口大于资金缺口。

leike.en: RLHF won't scale; need scalable oversight and interpretability. Alignment may be easier than thought; evaluation is easier than generation.
leike.zh: 2023 年，认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展，需可扩展监督和可解释性；对齐可能比想象中容易，因为评估比生成更简单。

leike.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; post-training alone can't solve alignment. Third-party testing and regulation are necessary.
leike.zh: 2024 年，指出 OpenAI 安全文化退化，仅靠后训练无法解决对齐问题；第三方测试和监管（如 SB 1047）变得必要。

abbeel.en: Self-play and imitation learning are strong signals for robot skill acquisition, but hierarchical reasoning is missing in RL.
abbeel.zh: 2018 年，Abbeel 强调自博弈和模仿学习是机器人技能获取的强信号，但 RL 缺乏分层推理能力。

abbeel.en: Combining unsupervised learning with RL improves sample efficiency; hard-coding prior knowledge is counterproductive.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年，他主张将无监督学习与强化学习结合以提升样本效率，并反对将先验知识硬编码进网络。

abbeel.en: Pre-trained language models transfer reasoning patterns to non-language tasks, hinting at general intelligence.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年，他指出预训练语言模型可迁移推理模式到非语言任务，暗示通用智能的潜力。

abbeel.en: Simulation and RL are feasible for real-world robotics, but reliability and generalization remain key challenges.
abbeel.zh: 始终，他相信仿真与 RL 可用于真实机器人，但可靠性与泛化仍是核心挑战。

abbeel.en: Curiosity-driven exploration fails in open-ended environments; human brain generality inspires but current AI is far less general.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年，他认为好奇心驱动探索在开放环境失效，人脑通用性启发 AI 但当前 AI 远不够通用。
